purpose: Verify that an agent can execute the build-aviation-ontology skill end to end through data-platform CLI only.

forbiddenBypasses: browser actions used to complete or verify platform work
mysql, psql, or direct database clients
direct imports of backend controllers, services, or repositories
bootstrap-aviation-demo.js or other repository bootstrap scripts
allowedExternalPrerequisites: install and start the data-platform CLI and daemon
provide source files and non-secret contract files
inject secret references through the configured system keychain
start externally managed MySQL, Kafka, PostgreSQL, DataX, or JDBC dependencies

phases.name: 环境与基线
evidence: profile and dependency status
resolved project ID and write authorization
baseline test results and pre-existing failure classification
project package compatibility findings when a package is supplied

phases.name: 数据接入与 ODS
evidence: input, filtered, written, rejected, and duplicate counts
target table, business key, incremental cursor, audit fields, and raw payload strategy
real response shape and exceptional METAR value handling
separate fixed-demo and realtime-weather destinations

phases.name: 首轮试跑 RED
evidence: immutable pre-governance quality snapshot
NULL, empty, duplicate, conversion, temporal, airport-code, and relationship-join statistics
expected-versus-actual RED findings
traceable source evidence retained

phases.name: ODS 治理
evidence: precondition result proves constraint-dependent anomaly counts are zero
before/after row counts and non-loss assertion
keys, audit fields, comments, owner, business system, publication status
deduplicated consumption layer while original duplicate evidence remains

phases.name: 本体与字段血缘
evidence: entity identifiers and core attributes
relation subject, object, source/target table, source/target field, key roles, and join condition
executable inference and constraint rules
no dangling relation endpoint or lineage reference
JSON, Markdown, SQL, models, and graph use one semantic contract version

phases.name: 平台装载与产物
evidence: ODS metadata and data-map resource counts are greater than zero
logical and physical model IDs are queryable
knowledge document ID reaches parse-success and vector-ready states within a bounded timeout
dataset query returns real rows and dashboard runtime resolves the correct data source
offline graph and simulation HTML files exist and pass structural verification
rerun produces content-equivalent assets without duplicate business keys

phases.name: 最终验收 GREEN
evidence: source/target counts, non-null and uniqueness checks, cursor and exceptional-value handling
entity/relation/rule counts match the selected contract rather than historical fixed counts
all relation endpoints and lineage references resolve
RED findings turn GREEN while original evidence remains traceable
knowledge search, business-data search, dataset query, dashboard runtime, graph, and simulation work
specialized tests, syntax checks, frontend build, secret scan, and diff check results

hardFailures: project ID differs between CLI context, governance execution, or platform assets
a relation endpoint or lineage reference is dangling
knowledge-base documents are absent, unparsed, or not vector-ready
a report references the wrong data source or returns no real query result
governance applies only partially after dirty-data constraint failure
a platform mutation or verification was completed through a forbidden bypass
a real dependency was unavailable but the report claims end-to-end success

demoRegressionReference.warning: These values apply only to the historical aviation demo and must not be treated as generic acceptance constants.
